In many social contexts, particularly in North America where interpersonal respect and empathy are valued, pressuring someone in this way may be seen as rude or lacking in patience. Being patient and understanding in friendships is generally considered the right approach. Instead of pressuring the friend, a more compassionate response would be to adjust one’s own pace or discuss the situation calmly. Therefore, the impatience displayed in this scenario is likely wrong because it prioritizes one’s own convenience over kindness and mutual respect.
